findings.mechanism: 07-connection-pools — a pool is a queue; with pool_size=10 and max_overflow=0, 40 concurrent with_session calls can only hold 10 connections, causing queueing and latency spikes.
findings.remediation: increase pool_size to match expected concurrency or set max_overflow>0, e.g., create_async_engine(..., pool_size=20, max_overflow=10)
findings.arithmetic: pool_size=10, max_overflow=0 → max simultaneous connections=10. Experiment runs 40 concurrent with_session calls; active connections cannot exceed 10, so expect saturation at 10 connections.
